💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Ugly Stare: Never let it finish basking. Its scales go molten gold as it charges — hit it while it basks and the charge dies unspent — a stun, a shout, a thrown rock, anything that breaks its focus. Interruptible: the bask is a ritual, and rituals need quiet. Don't let it finish. Every uninterrupted turn is a loaded bite. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
